### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans

* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/

* The Plant Manager is responsible for assisting the Director of Plant Services in engineering, custodial, and minor maintenance at selected facilities as assigned by the Director of Plant Services by starting, stopping, and observing all equipment that is interconnected with the air conditioning and/or heating system, safety, security, cleanliness, and the entire appearance at various facilities.

**Scope of

* Sets up for assemblies, conferences, plays, programs when required.
* Supervises custodial staff, inspects their work, assigns duties, keeps and reports the time for himself/ herself and personnel, etc. in coordination with principal.
* Light maintenance functions, makes minor repairs such as replacing faucet handles, light switches, door knobs and door adjustments, glass repairs, painting, etc. for all buildings on school plant.
* Responsible to carry and answers system issued iPhone before, during and after normal work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety

* Collaborative management style, with a proven track record of working with diverse individuals at all levels to drive decision-making and results.
* Maintain a valid Louisiana drivers’ license.
* Have knowledge of driving laws, interpreting traffic signals, signs.
* Ability to operate a manual transmission.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED/Hi Set
* Two years of experience in a mechanical trade.
* Two years of college

The PM has direct responsibility for the overall operation of the Birdsboro plant. This position is responsible for the Birdsboro sites Replacement Asset Value (RAV) of approximately $120 million (original purchase cost of approximately $65 million), Replacement Plant Earnings (RPE) of approximately $12 million, annual variable costs exceeding $75 million (including monomers), and annual CAPEX of $4-5 million.

This positio

postingQuotes:
Director of Quality
Harvest Solar, an equal opportunity employer, is a Michigan-based company that provides cost-effective renewable energy for agriculture, commercial, and utility customers yielding more energy independence by utilizing solar energy. We believe in energy independence and a sustainable future for our children and grandchildren. Our purpose is to empower people to create and use renewable energy by providing them with the best‐in‐class service, products, and experience. 
 
**Position Title and Purpose of Position** 
The Director of Quality will develop, coordinate, and implemen

* Ensure a “Safe Culture” through employee engagement, training, coaching, and compliance
* Responsible for planning, developing, implementing, maintaining, and improving quality and commissioning policies and procedures in compliance with Harvest requirements along with customer, Utility, and AHJ requirements
* Responsible for planning, developing, implementing, and providing quality and commissioning training for relevant employees
* Identifies opportunities to improve existing policies and procedures
* Maintain quality and commissioning records using Procore and other customer required syst

The Director of Quality will develop, coordinate, and implement quality and commissioning policies and procedures to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations throughout the organization. The Director of Quality is responsible for site specific quality and commissioning compliance within both Harvest’s and the customer’s requirements. The Director of Quality will work closely with onsite Harvest Solar project management, direct-labor staff, customer’s representatives, and subcontractors to ensure all work is completed to established requirements.

**Salary** 
The salary range for this r

* Good understanding of data analysis and risk assessment
* Good organizational, leadership and motivational skills
* Maintain regular and acceptable attendance
* Willing to work hours necessary to support the accomplishment of organizational goals

**Educational and Certification Background**

* High school diploma or GED – Required.
* Bachelor’s degree in safety management and five years’ experience; or ten years’ experience coordinating safety & environmental programs; experience in construction environment preferred.
* Valid State Driver’s License – Required
* OSHA 30 - Preferred
* MIOSHA
